channels.pitch: If you've used or learned from our public software and research, you can now send a one-time tip to keep the work independent. The code stays open, and no exclusive rights are sold.

What if independent researchers and builders could be funded without enclosing their work? We're publishing our tools openly. Here's proof of what already exists—and a tip jar for anyone delighted enough to back it.
I thought you might enjoy the open software and research we've actually published. If it resonates, there's a simple way to support it; the outputs stay public and you buy no influence.
